payload.notes: C2 Hercules: large rear-access bay. Prefer flat deck layers; keep a clear center aisle when practical.
guidelines: Load from the ramp (rear) first when stacking deep.
Keep full-height stacks toward the back of the bay.

payload.notes: Mk V Centaurus: narrower bay; pack flat layers and avoid blocking the center path.
guidelines: Prefer three-wide 8 SCU footprints where the bay allows.
Do not wall off forward cells with full-height stacks.
Prioritized / Mission based: early deliveries toward bay edges; later deliveries toward the center.
